_status: INERT EXAMPLE. Claude Code does not read this file. Nothing runs until you copy the value of example_settings.hooks into the hooks key of your own .claude/settings.json (project) or .claude/settings.local.json (personal). Agents never do this unless the user explicitly asks for an editor hook.
_purpose: After Claude Code edits or writes an HTML or component template file inside the project, run the SEO-GEO-god JSON-LD check on that one file. Error-level findings (malformed JSON-LD, unescaped </script, unreplaced placeholders) are sent back to Claude through stderr with exit code 2 so it can fix them; warnings and infos are not reported by the hook. The hook only reads the edited file and writes nothing.
_requirements: A copy of the seo-geo-god plugin at <project>/tools/seo-geo-god, or the environment variable SEO_GEO_GOD_DIR pointing at the plugin directory (the one that contains scripts/seo_geo.py).
Files outside the project directory, files with other extensions and missing files are ignored.
_risks: Runs a Python process after every matching edit; each run is limited to 25 seconds by the script and 30 seconds by the hook timeout.
Template blocks with template expressions are skipped in source (rule SD019); keep validating built output in CI.
Hooks run with your user permissions. Read the command before enabling it, and keep it in a settings file you control.
A hook that reports errors on every edit can slow an agent down; disable it if it gets in the way.
_enable: Open your project's .claude/settings.json (create it if missing).
Copy the object under example_settings.hooks into that file's top-level hooks key, merging with any hooks you already have.
Restart the Claude Code session or review hooks with the /hooks command so the change is picked up.
_verify: Ask Claude Code to write a test HTML file containing <script type="application/ld+json">{"@context": "https://schema.org",}</script> inside the project; the hook should report SD001. Delete the test file afterwards.
_disable: Remove the PostToolUse entry from your settings file.
_needs_verification: Hook event names, the tool_input.file_path field, exit-code semantics (2 sends stderr to Claude) and CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR follow Claude Code's hooks documentation as understood on 2026-11-01. Check your installed version's hooks documentation before enabling.

hooks.command:
python3 -I -c 'import json, os, subprocess, sys
EXTS = (".html", ".htm", ".jsx", ".tsx", ".vue", ".svelte", ".astro", ".php", ".liquid", ".njk", ".erb", ".ejs", ".hbs")
try:
    event = json.load(sys.stdin)
except ValueError:
    sys.exit(0)
tool_input = event.get("tool_input") if isinstance(event, dict) else None
path = tool_input.get("file_path") if isinstance(tool_input, dict) else None
root = os.environ.get("CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR")
if not isinstance(path, str) or not root or not path.lower().endswith(EXTS) or not os.path.isfile(path):
    sys.exit(0)
real_root, real_path = os.path.realpath(root), os.path.realpath(path)
if os.path.commonpath([real_root, real_path]) != real_root:
    sys.exit(0)
plugin = os.environ.get("SEO_GEO_GOD_DIR") or os.path.join(real_root, "tools", "seo-geo-god")
cli = os.path.join(plugin, "scripts", "seo_geo.py")
if not os.path.isfile(cli):
    sys.exit(0)
try:
    proc = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-I", cli, "jsonld", real_path, "--format", "text", "--fail-on", "error"], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=25)
except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
    sys.stderr.write("seo-geo-god jsonld timed out\n")
    sys.exit(1)
if proc.returncode == 1:
    sys.stderr.write(proc.stdout[-4000:])
    sys.exit(2)
if proc.returncode:
    sys.stderr.write("seo-geo-god jsonld could not run (exit %d)\n" % proc.returncode)
    sys.exit(1)
sys.exit(0)
'
